Lockbox Master key
==================

[Sign In to Save](https://auth.fandom.com/register?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fdungeondefenders2.fandom.com%2Fwiki%2FLockbox_Master_key%3Fcollections%3Dsave&uselang=en&metadata=collections-save-button)

Master key's can be purchased at the Treasure Pirate for ?? Gems or 500 [Defender Medals](https://dungeondefenders2.fandom.com/wiki/Defender_Medal "Defender Medal")
. Master keys are used to open obtainable Lockboxes which can be drop from mini-bosses. Upon opening a Lockbox the player obtains a random cosmetic item of that class.
